## 2B.2 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** I found **no credible 2024 evidence** that Lula initiated, expanded, prolonged, or justified a war of choice, annexation, covert destabilization, or proxy conflict beyond defensive necessity. The 2024 record points strongly toward diplomacy, ceasefire, and de-escalation. The main caveat is that Lula’s Gaza rhetoric was sharply confrontational, and the Brazil-China Ukraine plan was criticized as exclusionary, but neither amounts to a war-of-choice pattern.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Lula framed the Ukraine and Gaza crises as matters for peace and negotiation, not military solutions.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and Planalto separately reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts. This supports the absence of war-of-choice behavior.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.1`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Brazil and China’s Ukraine initiative advocated talks and a ceasefire, not escalation.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. This is evidence against any effort to prolong or justify war.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula publicly argued against militarized confrontation at the UN in 2024.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula warned that nuclear arsenals and destructive weapons were driving confrontation and said direct dialogue was crucial. This reinforces that he was not justifying conflict expansion.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula’s summit speech also rejected living with nuclear threats and called for multilateral reform.
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world could not go back to living with nuclear threats and linked that warning to arms-race criticism. This is the opposite of justifying aggressive conflict or proxy war.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`

### Counterevidence / caveats

- **Claim:** Lula’s Gaza rhetoric was confrontational and worsened diplomatic relations, but it was still not a war-of-choice justification.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula repeated a genocide accusation and defended Palestinian statehood, prompting a diplomatic rupture with Israel. This is the strongest negative signal in 2024, but it is rhetoric, not evidence of Lula initiating or prolonging a war.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Ukraine criticized the Brazil-China peace initiative as exclusionary and “destructive.”
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said Kyiv was not included and argued the plan lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. This weakens the initiative’s credibility, but it still points toward mediation rather than war expansion or proxy conflict.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.2`; also `1B.4`, `1B.8`

### Search gap

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Lula:
- initiated a war of choice,
- expanded or prolonged a proxy conflict,
- justified annexation or cross-border coercion,
- or used covert destabilization as state policy.

The evidence I found is overwhelmingly de-escalatory. The only meaningful negatives are rhetorical and diplomatic friction, not war-making.
